# TabsVariant

`Flare.Components.TabsVariant`

Visual style of a FlareTabs bar, independent of the active theme. Each theme reskins the variants through its tokens, so a variant looks native everywhere (e.g. Filled is a solid accent pill). Four names mirror ButtonVariant (Text/Tonal/Filled/Outlined).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | The active theme's default tab style (typically a simple underline indicator). |
| `Underline` | `1` | Full-width underline active indicator. |
| `Primary` | `2` | Content-hugging underline indicator with rounded top corners. |
| `Secondary` | `3` | Full-width underline indicator with the active label in the content colour rather than the accent. Pairs with Primary: primary tabs mark top-level destinations, secondary tabs subdivide one of them, and the quieter active label is what keeps the two levels from competing when they are stacked. |
| `Text` | `4` | No persistent indicator: the active tab is color/weight only, with a subtle hover wash. |
| `Tonal` | `5` | Active tab filled with a soft tonal pill. |
| `Filled` | `6` | Active tab filled with the solid accent as a pill / segmented control. |
| `Outlined` | `7` | Bordered card / folder tabs that connect to the panel below (classic "card" tabs). |

## Used by components

- `FlareTabs`
